build.buildCommand: cd frontend && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build

deploy.startCommand: cd frontend && (npx prisma migrate deploy --schema ../backend/prisma/schema.prisma || npx prisma db push --skip-generate --schema ../backend/prisma/schema.prisma) && HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 NODE_ENV=production node .next/standalone/frontend/server.js
